questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] Which of the following religions prohibits the consumption of root vegetables?
A. Zoroastrianism B. Jainism C. Shinto
Answer: B. Followers of Jainism avoid eating root vegetables such as potatoes, onions, and garlic to prevent harm to small organisms in the soil and to avoid killing the plants themselves, which aligns with their principles of non-violence and respect for all forms of life.
questions.de: Die Anhänger welcher indischen Religion meiden Wurzelgemüse wie Kartoffeln, Zwiebeln und Knoblauch, um winzige Lebewesen im Boden nicht zu verletzen und keine ganzen Pflanzen zu entwurzeln?
questions.en: Followers of which Indian religion avoid root vegetables such as potatoes, onions and garlic, so as not to harm tiny organisms in the soil or uproot whole plants?

timeline.labelEn: Mahavira, the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism (traditional dates c. 599–527 BCE)
timeline.labelDe: Mahavira, der 24. Tirthankara des Jainismus (traditionelle Daten um 599–527 v. Chr.)

questions.notes: Confirmed: Jain diet restricts root and underground vegetables (potatoes, onions, garlic) to spare microscopic life (nigoda) and avoid uprooting plants. Timeline uses Mahavira's traditional Śvetāmbara dates; historians date him less precisely (6th or early 5th century BCE).

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] What disease was the first vaccine made for?
A. Polio B. Measles C. Smallpox
Answer: C. The first successful vaccine developed was for smallpox by Edward Jenner in 1796. He used material from cowpox sores to provide immunity against smallpox, a technique that laid the foundation for modern vaccinology.
questions.de: Gegen welche Krankheit entwickelte Edward Jenner 1796 mit Material aus Kuhpockenbläschen den ersten Impfstoff?
questions.en: Against which disease did Edward Jenner develop the first vaccine in 1796, using material from cowpox sores?

timeline.labelEn: Edward Jenner inoculates James Phipps with cowpox, the first vaccination against smallpox
timeline.labelDe: Edward Jenner impft James Phipps mit Kuhpocken, die erste Impfung gegen die Pocken

questions.notes: Confirmed: the smallpox vaccine was the first vaccine developed against a contagious disease (Jenner, 1796). Date of the Phipps inoculation from Wikipedia's Edward Jenner article.
